name: The Invisible Enemy
description: A series through 1 and 2 Thessalonians on readiness for Christ’s return, life in the church family, and standing firm against the lawless one.
note: The Work of Unity is not in the playlist, but Josh preaches 2 Thessalonians 3 as part of this series.

provenance.detail: The official The Invisible Enemy playlist includes Are You Ready?.
The official The Invisible Enemy playlist includes Walking & Waiting.
The official The Invisible Enemy playlist includes Community on 🔥.
The official The Invisible Enemy playlist includes Who Do You Marvel At?.
The official The Invisible Enemy playlist includes The Lawless One.
Josh opens by saying the invisible enemy is at work and takes the church to 2 Thessalonians as he speaks of this series.
